_meta.what_this_is: Six personal notes, a concept map, and six queries split into two kinds. EXACT queries hinge on a rare token (14c, b4, 28th) that only a surface match can find. PARAPHRASE queries use synonyms (commute, exercise, checkup) that share no surface word with the note but the same concept. The concept map is a hand-built stand-in for a learned embedding: it groups synonyms under one concept, and words it has no concept for (the rare tokens) are dropped -- exactly how an embedding blurs a rare token.
_meta.results_are: A FIXTURE. Authored so lexical wins every exact query and loses every paraphrase, dense does the reverse, and a hybrid must fuse them. Point the methods at your own corpus and queries.
_meta.query_types: exact = answerable only by a rare surface token; paraphrase = answerable only by a shared concept
_meta.format: docs {id: text}; concepts {word: concept}; queries [{q, gold_doc, type}]
